headline: Dealer-level repairs, without the dealer.
intro: Forks Auto Repair is run by Stephen Cook, a former Toyota master technician. When you book in, you deal with the person who actually works on your car.
about:
Stephen spent years as a master technician at Toyota, working on everything from routine maintenance to hard-to-find electrical faults. He opened Forks Auto Repair to give drivers that same level of skill with straight answers and fair prices.

You'll get an estimate before any work starts, and he'll call you before doing anything that wasn't on it.

faqs.q: Will I know the price before you start?
faqs.a: Yes. You get an estimate before any work starts, and Stephen calls you before doing anything that wasn't on it.
Call us or book online. Online bookings are requests: we'll call, text or email to confirm the day and time.
You can. Scan the code at the counter to check in on your phone and we'll fit you in when we can. Booking ahead is the surest way to be seen the same day.
